title: Terms and Purrditions
status: 20-minute scene plan, not a production-ready shot list

scenes.title: Breakfast on Wheels
scenes.action: The five deliver the first community salmon crates. A family has food for tonight. Byte insists on keeping a receipt for every handover.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Establish the tangible success inherited from the pilot.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Payment Declined
scenes.action: A customer can see funds but cannot pay. The clerk tries a second account; it is blocked too. Trixie recognizes the delivery recipient list.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: An account freeze turns the victory into a new problem.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Sorry Costs Extra
scenes.action: The help terminal prints a thirty-seven-page apology and charges a processing fee. Onyx asks whether the apology needs an apology. Neon saves the reference number.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: A comic obstacle creates the evidence trail rather than delaying it.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Three Locks, One Key
scenes.action: Byte compares food-payment IDs, the warehouse lease and utility access. The same corporate identity ledger governs all three. Ghost warns that an overwrite would destroy provenance.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Define the system and the limits of the crew’s options.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: The Freeze Order
scenes.action: Barkington authorizes enhanced fraud review for District 7 recipients and an accelerated lease inspection. The public explanation is administrative protection.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Reveal intent through a signed fictional administrative order.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Receipts on the Table
scenes.action: The crew lays paper receipts beside matching account notices. Trixie wants immediate relief; Byte points out that erasing balances also erases the overcharge evidence.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Make the central moral and practical choice concrete.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Keep the Evidence
scenes.action: They choose to preserve the signed account-change record and appeal the freeze. Ghost needs a legitimate copy exposed through a public service case; no magical total access.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Set a constrained, comprehensible plan.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Offline Does Not Mean Forgotten
scenes.action: Neon makes a paper-first delivery register. Onyx verifies names at the door. A resident fears losing access by being listed; they explain what is and is not recorded.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: The community gets agency and practical protection.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Take a Number
scenes.action: At the public-service annex, the number dispenser sends them to a second dispenser. Onyx starts documenting every rule instead of breaking the queue.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Introduce the service set and a comic strategy that pays off.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: A Fee to Dispute a Fee
scenes.action: A terminal demands payment before accepting a frozen-account complaint. Trixie finds the hardship exception; the terminal demands proof they cannot pay.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: A specific procedural trap increases pressure.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Every Posted Rule
scenes.action: Onyx reads the entire posted policy and spots a paper-appeal option. He calmly refuses the express fee and requests the required acknowledgment.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: His patience, rather than intimidation, earns the case number.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Signed and Dated
scenes.action: The case attachment contains the signed freeze-order record. Byte compares its time to the public explanation and delivery receipts. They preserve an unmodified copy.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Acquire evidence through the established appeal, not an unexplained hack.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Protection on Television
scenes.action: WOOF7 calls the freezes a voluntary consumer-protection review. Cut to affected residents unable to buy supper; broadcast stays in the physical television when viewed in-world.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Show the gap between official language and lived consequences.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: The Lease Clock
scenes.action: A notice on the warehouse door gives a near-term compliance deadline. The organic officer delivers paperwork, while the robot-factory design remains separate.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Link the warehouse threat to the same identity ledger.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Copy, Do Not Erase
scenes.action: Trixie declines the tempting destructive shortcut. Byte creates a comparison package containing receipts, timestamps and the signed order, with resident details withheld from the public copy.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Pay off the evidence-versus-erasure choice.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: The Appeal Token
scenes.action: Neon brings the acknowledgment and the preserved attachments back to the terminal. The receipt number unlocks a manual review channel hidden in plain sight.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: The queue comedy becomes the mechanism for progress.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: The Clerk’s Receipt
scenes.action: The shopkeeper adds a witnessed receipt showing the same customers paid normally before the order. The clerk risks extra scrutiny but chooses to sign.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: A civilian action supplies the corroboration the crew lacked.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Barkington’s Denial
scenes.action: Barkington insists the restrictions are routine and that no neighborhood is being singled out. A screen beside him shows the District 7 selection field.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: His specific denial can be tested against the evidence.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: NIP7 Puts It Together
scenes.action: The British cat presenter explains the signed order and the timeline, distinguishing proven retaliation from unanswered questions. Residents are not exposed on screen.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Publish a clear factual win, not an all-powerful leak.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: The Queue Turns Around
scenes.action: Residents arrive with numbered paper appeals and their own receipts. Onyx helps them follow the rules the corporation expected nobody to read.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: The victory is collective; the crew does not solve everything alone.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Access Restored
scenes.action: The manual review restores the flagged accounts. The terminal displays a temporary review decision, not permanent control over the ledger.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Resolve the immediate freeze within the established mechanism.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Dinner Gets Delivered
scenes.action: Payment succeeds at the shop and the delivery register balances. The same family from the opening gets supper. Byte keeps the final receipt.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Demonstrate the result physically instead of only announcing it.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Thirty Days Is Not Forever
scenes.action: The warehouse receives a temporary reprieve. The crew celebrates a real win while acknowledging the shared ledger still exists. Onyx keeps the huge apology as a doorstop.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Close the comic thread and state the limits of the victory.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written

scenes.title: Redevelopment
scenes.action: An appendix to the account record marks District 7 as a planned redevelopment zone. Trixie realizes the freeze was a pressure tactic connected to something larger.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: End on the approved redevelopment hook, not the later BARK-camera finale.
scenes.status: planning draft; shot breakdown and full dialogue not yet written
